hooks.command: f="${PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/bin/hook.js"; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "agent-workflow hook is missing at $f; restart Codex after plugin updates" >&2; exit 2; }; node "$f" codex || { s=$?; [ $s -eq 2 ] && exit 2; echo "agent-workflow hook could not run (exit $s)" >&2; exit 2; }

f="${PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/bin/hook.js"; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "agent-workflow hook is missing at $f; restart Codex after plugin updates" >&2; exit 2; }; node "$f" codex || { s=$?; [ $s -eq 2 ] && exit 2; echo "agent-workflow hook could not run (exit $s)" >&2; exit 2; }
